ratio.label: Margin ratio

info: Simulation parameters: initial ratio {{initial}}, call level {{call}}, danger level {{maintenance}}. Concepts follow Decision 87/QĐ-UBCK. At the end of each session the system collects debt from cash if auto-repay is on. This simulation only warns and never force-sells.

loans.title: Loans
loans.empty: Turn on “Use margin” when placing a buy order to borrow.

settings.title: Service settings
settings.description: Takes effect from the next session
settings.autoRepayHint: At session end, cash pays interest then principal, oldest loan first
settings.autoRenewHint: Loans that fall due are renewed if eligible

activation.title: Open a margin account
activation.description: Borrow to buy stocks, up to twice your cash. Gains and losses are both amplified.
activation.know1: Buying with borrowed money amplifies both gains and losses.
activation.know2: When the margin ratio drops below {{rate}}, you get a warning to repay.
activation.know3: This simulation only warns and never force-sells.
activation.kycRequired: eKYC verification is required to open a margin account

open.title: Open margin account
open.description: Simulated under public regulations, no real money involved
open.accept: I understand the risks of margin trading

package.needAccount: Open a margin account to register a package
package.registerDescription: Approved immediately and applies to new loans. Existing loans keep their package.
package.cancelDescription: New loans will use the Basic package. Existing loans keep their package.
package.conflictDescription: The {{name}} and {{target}} packages cannot be used together. Cancel {{name}} first, then register again.
package.title: Loan packages
package.sectionHint: Applies to new loans. Click a package to see details and register.
package.howFixed: Each day: outstanding principal × {{rate}} ÷ 365, including the loan day. Repayments cover interest first, then principal.
package.howBasket: Each day: outstanding principal × {{rate}} ÷ 365 for loans on basket stocks. Loans on other stocks use {{basic}}/yr like the Basic package.
package.howTiered: The rate depends on how many days you have held the loan, counted from the loan day. Each day: principal × tier rate ÷ 365.
package.noteNew: Approved instantly and applies to new loans. Existing loans keep their rate.
package.noteExclusive: To switch to the {{name}} package, cancel this one first.
package.noteBasic: Cancelling Preferred or Tiered returns new loans to this package.
package.noteTerm: {{days}}-day term, renewable within {{window}} days of the due date, up to {{count}} times.

BASIC.name: Basic
BASIC.tagline: Default package, covers every marginable stock
BASIC.condition1: Applies to every stock with a loan ratio

PREFERRED.name: Preferred
PREFERRED.tagline: Lower interest for a basket of large caps
PREFERRED.condition1: Only applies to stocks in the basket
PREFERRED.condition2: Loans for stocks outside the basket use the Basic package
PREFERRED.condition3: Cannot be used together with the Tiered package

TIERED.name: Tiered
TIERED.tagline: Interest-free first days, suits short holdings
TIERED.condition1: Interest rises with the number of days held
TIERED.condition2: Applies to every stock with a loan ratio
TIERED.condition3: Cannot be used together with the Preferred package

illustration.description: Compare profit using only cash versus borrowing under each package. Trading fees, sell tax and interest are included.
illustration.invalid: Enter capital, buy price, sell price and days to see results
illustration.note: For reference only, assuming you sell at the target price after the given number of days.

repay.title: Repay margin loan
repay.description: Repay part or all of a loan with cash
repay.interestFirst: Payments cover interest first, the rest goes to principal.

renew.title: Renew {{code}}?
renew.description: New due date: {{date}} (+{{days}} days). {{left}} renewals left after this one.

unavailable.RENEW_TOO_EARLY: Renewal opens {{days}} days before the due date
unavailable.MARGIN_RATIO_TOO_LOW: Margin ratio is below the call level

call.title: Margin call
call.description: Your margin ratio fell below the call level of {{rate}}
call.note: This simulation only warns and never force-sells. Calls are kept in the History tab.
call.toastDescription: Repay to bring the account back to a safe level.

errors.PACKAGE_CONFLICT: Another package that cannot be combined is active, cancel it first

errors.MARGIN_RATIO_TOO_LOW: Margin ratio is below the call level
